tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page background. The console's ground in both themes.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, panels, the investigation thread, tables.

tokens.name: surface-sunken
tokens.usage: Code and evidence windows, the ask box, wells inside a card.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines, table rules, card borders on surface and surface-raised.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input borders, dividers that must be seen, the causal chain's connectors. 3:1 on surface in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text, on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunken.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, the stat row, on any surface.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only. Not for body copy.

tokens.name: beam
tokens.usage: The accent: links, the active nav item, the primary button fill, the probe-online dot. As text, on surface, surface-raised and beam-soft.

tokens.name: beam-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind beam text and the selected row.

tokens.name: on-beam
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a beam fill: the primary button label.

tokens.name: approve
tokens.usage: Awaiting approval, and only that. The approval card's border and the awaiting chip. As text on surface, surface-raised and approve-soft.

tokens.name: approve-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind approve text, the awaiting-approval chip.

tokens.name: critical
tokens.usage: Critical severity and destructive actions. As text on surface, surface-raised and critical-soft. Always paired with the word Critical.

tokens.name: critical-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind critical text and the critical chip.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Warning severity. As text on surface, surface-raised and warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind warning text and the warning chip.

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Info severity and informational notes. As text on surface, surface-raised and info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind info text and the info chip.

tokens.name: ok
tokens.usage: Healthy, verified, resolved. As text on surface, surface-raised and ok-soft. Differs from critical in lightness in both themes, and is always paired with a word.

tokens.name: ok-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind ok text and the resolved chip.

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: The focus ring, solid 2px, on every surface. At least 3:1 on each surface in both themes.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Page titles and the finding headline on the investigation page.

styles.name: heading
styles.usage: Headings inside cards and the thread.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: The 01:52 deploy carried a smaller pool size into production.
styles.usage: Running text in findings, guidelines and dialogs.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrows and column headers. Set text-transform: uppercase on the element.

styles.name: data
styles.usage: Identifiers, resource ids, metric names, source pointers, timestamps. Always tabular-nums.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The one number a tile is about. Tabular-nums.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Gap between a chip and its label, icon to text.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips and small buttons, gap between stacked rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Table cell padding, gap between cards in a row.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, the page gutter at phone width.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Gap between sections inside a page.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Page padding on desktop, the gap under a page title.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Between major regions of a page.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Chips, code spans, table row highlights.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Panels, the approval card, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Status dots and the probe-state pill only.

tokens.name: shadow-raise
tokens.usage: Cards on surface. Borders do most of the work; the shadow only lifts a card a hair.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Dialogs and menus only.
